title: Local vs. Global Digital Marketing Strategies Explored

facts.fact: The AD GUYS & CO blog post 'Local vs. Global Digital Marketing Strategies Explored' was posted on 29 April 2024 in the Digital Marketing category.
The article uses Singapore as its market context and cites the Tiong Bahru and Bugis neighborhoods as examples of hyper-local targeting by local agencies.
